snapshot_purpose: Track deterministic Hermes skills that call and govern the terminal loadout system: launch routing, prompt enhancement, real-home rules, visible launch disclosure, watcher closeout, and runtime-specific Claude/Codex operation.
sync_rule: When a reviewed Hermes slash-command or loadout workflow intentionally changes coding-terminal behavior, copy the corresponding deterministic skill directories here and commit the diff with the related loadout-system change. Do not auto-sync or self-update during a run.
self_update_policy: never self-update from inside a managed coding-terminal run
growth_policy: Do not mutate these deterministic gateway skills as ambient memory. Grow behavior through reviewed slash-command/loadout changes, new shared skills, new loadout packs, or explicit source-ingestion commits.
